_comment: Copy to trigger_config.json next to lark_config.json (both gitignored). bot_open_id is optional: when empty the scripts resolve this app's bot id automatically via /bot/v3/info. url_filter (optional) makes only links containing the substring fire, so random links in chat do not trigger sends. link_map maps a model slug (substring of the link) to a prepared Brevo request JSON; links with no slug match are queued for the compose agent instead. brevo_script (optional) points at run_brevo_email.py; empty means use the sibling brevo skill (skills/brevo/scripts/run_brevo_email.py).
